local_checks.invariant: A submodule diff.external must not run when the viewer diffs a superproject that sets diff.submodule=diff.
local_checks.result: Closed. base_git_command now passes -c diff.submodule=short. On git 2.43.0 the prior marker ran only when that -c was omitted. With the viewer argv the marker was absent and the child diff --submodule=diff was not spawned. Prior fingerprint src/git.rs:git_command:nested-submodule-unhardened-child is rejected as fixed.

local_checks.invariant: A clean filter configured only in a populated submodule must not run during status or diff.
local_checks.result: Fails. git status and git diff still spawn git status --porcelain=2 inside the submodule. That child runs a submodule-only clean filter selected by $GIT_DIR/info/attributes even with --attr-source and -c diff.submodule=short, when the file size matches the index. --ignore-submodules=dirty stops it. -c diff.ignoreSubmodules=dirty does not, if submodule.<name>.ignore=none is set.

local_checks.invariant: A clean filter configured only in a populated submodule must not run during status or diff.
local_checks.result: Independently reproduced on git 2.43.0 under unshare user/net/mount with an empty allowlisted environment. Marker created for viewer status and whole-tree diff when info/attributes selected a submodule-only clean filter and the worktree size matched the index. Marker absent for a size-changing edit, for worktree .gitattributes while --attr-source was set, for status --ignore-submodules=dirty despite submodule.sub.ignore=none, and for diff.external while -c diff.submodule=short was set.

assignment_notes: Revalidate #208 and #207. The prior diff.external fingerprint changed source and is not a hunter exclusion.
hardening: Git builtin aliases (alias.status, alias.diff, alias.config) do not replace builtins on git 2.43.0. A non-builtin alias.st does run. The viewer only invokes builtins.
